Name: QuestFlagInspector
Author: Moss (agent) for ACBuilds
Description: Read-only Sentinel /questflags <player>: dumps a target's full quest-flag registry to the caller's chat, closing the gap that ACE's own QuestManager.ShowQuests() only writes to the server console. Annotates each flag with times-completed, last-completed, and next-solve-time or max-solves-reached. OFF by default.
